What browser are you using? Note that the ChromosomeExplorer only
works with the Mozilla Firefox browser (v2 or newer), cf. FAQ.
2007-02-14: The NnnExplorer does not seem to work? (online).

FYI, I am no longer guaranteeing/validating that it will work with
Firefox v2, so I recommend that you upgrade to the latest Firefox v3.

For troubleshooting: On the main page of the aroma.affymetrix group,
there are links to two ChromosomeExplorer examples and one
ArrayExplorer example (slower because it has to download a larger
image). See if you can get those to work in your browser, then try
the same with the generated report you've got.

Let us know if this helps

/Henrik

PS. If anyone is interested in getting this to work with MS Internet
Explorer, Apple Safari or similar, contributions are welcomed. There
is nothing particular in the javascript that is hardwired to Firefox,
so the missing bits are probably only minor. DS.
